reforms.description: The government will promote the purchase of foreign automobiles and auto parts by providing financial support for exhibitions of foreign cars and assistance for design-in training, alongside improving standards and certification procedures.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This reform aims to enhance domestic demand and innovation in the automotive sector by facilitating the integration of foreign technology and standards.
reforms.status_evidence: The reform has been put into action as part of the government's economic initiatives.
reforms.importance_rationale: While not a major overhaul, this reform significantly supports innovation in the automotive sector.
reforms.source_quote: The government will promote the purchase of foreign automobiles and auto parts by providing financial support for exhibitions of foreign cars and assistance for design-in training.

reforms.description: The government announced a comprehensive economic package amounting to ¥15.3 trillion, which includes stimulus measures and deregulation efforts aimed at boosting domestic demand.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The comprehensive economic package is designed to stimulate the economy and promote innovation through deregulation and financial support.
reforms.status_evidence: The economic package has been executed as part of the government's strategy.
reforms.importance_rationale: This package represents a significant structural change aimed at revitalizing the economy.
reforms.source_quote: The government announces a comprehensive economic package amounting to ¥15.3 trillion.
